init.actor.recorded.text: Dinah ने आपको {path} में actor {actor} के रूप में दर्ज किया, और अब आप जो भी करेंगे, Dinah उस पर यही नाम दर्ज करेगी। इसे बदलने के लिए `dinah config set actor <name>` चलाएँ, या हटाने के लिए `dinah config set actor` चलाएँ।
init.actor.recorded.context: Printed after init records the actor in the person's own configuration. Dinah records it only when no flag, variable or setting already named an actor. {actor} is the name recorded and {path} is the file it was written to. The word Dinah names the product and stays in Latin script; do not respell it. The command text is typed literally and stays as it is.

init.actor.unrecorded.text: Dinah ने वर्कबेंच बना दिया, लेकिन {path} में आपको actor के रूप में दर्ज नहीं कर सकी ({reason})। आप कौन हैं यह बताने के लिए `dinah config set actor <name>` चलाएँ।
init.actor.unrecorded.context: Printed after init creates the workbench and then fails to write the person's own configuration. The workbench exists, so this is a report rather than a refusal and carries no refusal name. {path} is the file Dinah tried to write and {reason} is the cause, which arrives in English from the operating system. The word Dinah names the product and stays in Latin script; do not respell it. The command text is typed literally and stays as it is.

mcp.reach.nodefault.unbounded.text: आप किसी भी ऐसी वर्कबेंच तक पहुँच सकते हैं जिसे आप नाम दे सकें; इस सर्वर को कोई रूट नहीं दिया गया है और यह तयशुदा रूप से कुछ भी नहीं परोस रहा है। workbenches उपकरण को खोजने के लिए रूट चाहिए और यहाँ dinah.no-workbench-found के साथ मना करता है, इसलिए जो वर्कबेंच चाहिए उसे किसी भी दूसरे उपकरण की workbench property में सीधे नामें।
mcp.reach.nodefault.unbounded.context: The third paragraph of the working agreement when the server has no default workbench and no root: --root and DINAH_MCP_ROOT were both empty and discovery found nothing, so PathUnderRoot admits every candidate and only bench.Open's own checks can refuse one.

mcp.reach.unbounded.text: आप किसी भी ऐसी वर्कबेंच तक पहुँच सकते हैं जिसे आप नाम दे सकें; इस सर्वर को कोई रूट नहीं दिया गया है और यह तयशुदा रूप से {title} परोस रहा है। workbenches उपकरण को खोजने के लिए रूट चाहिए और यहाँ dinah.no-workbench-found के साथ मना करता है, इसलिए चाहें तो वर्कबेंच को किसी भी दूसरे उपकरण की workbench property में सीधे नामें, या तयशुदा वर्कबेंच के उपयोग के लिए इसे बिना नाम के छोड़ दें।
mcp.reach.unbounded.context: The third paragraph of the working agreement when the server has a default workbench but no root: --root and DINAH_MCP_ROOT were both empty, discovery found a workbench to serve as default, and the auto-narrowing that used to bind root to that workbench's own directory (dinah-307) no longer runs, so PathUnderRoot admits every other candidate too. {title} is the default workbench's own title.

contents.empty.context: Printed when `dinah contents` is asked about an entity with nothing below it. No table follows, and the call succeeds: an entity that contains nothing is an answer rather than a mistake.

tree.hidden.join.context: Joins the two halves of a Not shown cell on a node that is holding something back for both reasons at once. {first} is the depth's account and {second} the query's.

column.tree.title.context: Heading over an entity's own title in the tree both tree commands print. A group row carries nothing here. A column heading, which a reader has to be able to tell from the rows beneath it by its own text as well as by the rule under it. Each catalog decides for itself how a heading reads as a heading in its own language.

refusal.dinah.repeated-axis.text: एक समूहन श्रृंखला प्रत्येक अक्ष को एक बार नाम देती है, और यह {detail} को दो बार नाम देती है।
refusal.dinah.repeated-axis.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.repeated-axis. {detail} is the axis the reader typed twice. refusal.dinah.unknown-axis.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.unknown-axis, which a group-by chain naming a word this tool does not group on carries. {detail} is the word the reader typed. {axes} is the list of legal axis names, read off the tool's own table rather than written here, so an axis name is machine vocabulary and is never translated. refusal.dinah.unknown-axis.next is spliced on after this one.

refusal.dinah.unknown-depth.text: इस आदेश के लिए Dinah में {detail} नामक कोई गहराई स्तर नहीं है। यह जिन स्तरों को लेता है, वे हैं: {levels}।

tree.empty.context: Printed when a tree has no card in it at all, so nothing is drawn beneath the sentence above it.

column.tree.hidden.context: Heading over what a node is holding back. The whole column is dropped when no row fills it. tree.header.context: The sentence above the tree `dinah tree` prints, naming the workbench the tree was built from. {title} is the workbench's title, {ref} its slug, and {count} how many cards it holds. The table starts at this node's children, so no row repeats it.

column.tree.count.context: Heading over how many subjects a node accounts for. A card row under `dinah tree` carries nothing here, since a card is one card. A column heading, which a reader has to be able to tell from the rows beneath it by its own text as well as by the rule under it. Each catalog decides for itself how a heading reads as a heading in its own language.

tree.hidden.filter.context: The Not shown cell on a node the query removed cards from. {count} is how many cards at or below this node the query left out.

states.work.waiting.context: The value under the states listing's Work column on a state that waits on somebody outside the workbench, where no owner takes work up.

refusal.dinah.awaiting-outside.text: स्थिति {detail} कार्यपीठ के बाहर के किसी व्यक्ति की प्रतीक्षा में है, और वहाँ कोई कार्ड रखा या लिया नहीं जाता

states.work.none.context: The value under the states listing's Work column on a state where no owner takes work up, which is an intake state, a done state and a dinah.buffer. next.no-taker.text: यहाँ से कुछ नहीं लिया जाता
next.no-taker.context: Printed beside a state that offers no card because no act could take one up from there, in place of next.none, which says only that nothing is ready. A done state holding four ready cards prints this one.

next.take.claim.context: The value under the offers listing's Take column on a card an owner takes up where it stands. It names the command a reader types, so it reads as the act rather than as a sentence about it.

next.take.pull.context: The value under the offers listing's Take column on a card that leaves by a pull into the state beyond, because nobody takes work up where it stands. It names the command a reader types.

column.next.take.context: Heading over the act that takes the offered card, in the offers `dinah next` prints.
